record.question: Reserve Bank of India has removed the charges levied on fund transfers through NEFT and RTGS on the recommendation of:
record.explanation: Answer C: Nandan Nilekani-led Committee. The committee associated with review of digital payment charges was chaired by Nandan Nilekani; the source refers to the RBI decision on NEFT/RTGS charges. Reference: https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx?Id=11614&Mode=0. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: August 2019 (cover; exact day not stated). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
